title: Iceland votes on whether to restart talks on joining EU
summary: Iceland is holding a vote on whether to resume negotiations for joining the European Union, a decision that could reshape the country's relationship with Europe. The referendum comes after years of paused talks, reflecting complex public sentiment about EU membership and national sovereignty.
